title: Casita By The Sea - Vacation Rental in Rosemary Beach,FL | 30a Escapes
meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Casita By The Sea,” your perfect Rosemary Beach getaway! This pet-friendly 2-bedroom, 3-bath home is steps away from the heated Sky Pool and the Cabana Community Pool. Complete with parking for 2, modern appliances, and 4 bikes for cruising
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Casita By The Sea,” your perfect Rosemary Beach getaway! This pet-friendly 2-bedroom, 3-bath home is steps away from the heated Sky Pool and the Cabana Community Pool. Complete with parking for 2, modern appliances, and 4 bikes for cruising the beautiful neighborhood, it's the ideal retreat for up to 6 guests. Enjoy peace, style, and relaxation. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Designer Décor and Vaulted Ceilings for a luxurious, airy vibePet-Friendly Home with Secluded Outdoor SpaceSteps to the Heated Sky Pool (3 min walk) and Cabana Community Pool (5 min walk)Parking for 2 Vehicles in the DrivewayIncludes 4 Bikes for Exploring Rosemary BeachLocated in the Heart of the Award-Winning Rosemary Beach CommunityEager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Perfect size for our family of 6. The balcony off of the Primary Suite was so nice for morning coffee!" – Lora G.⭐"Great location and awesome property. Loved the pet-friendly option!" – Steve R.⭐"Ideal place to relax. Rosemary Beach was just steps away, along with pools and green space!" – Spriggs T.*** LIVING AREAS ***Step into an open-plan living area where vaulted ceilings and oversized windows create a bright, inviting space. Relax on the plush sofas while streaming your favorite movies using the surround sound system. The thoughtful designer touches and natural light make this home both stylish and comfortable.Bright Open Floor Plan with Vaulted Ceilings and Oversized WindowsGenerous Seating Area with Surround Sound SystemStylish Designer Décor for a premium feelAccess to a Front Porch*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***For foodies and casual cooks alike, the kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and everything you need to prepare your meals. Dine indoors at the cozy table or savor al fresco meals in the secluded outdoor oasis.Gourmet Kitchen with Stainless Steel AppliancesSpacious Granite Countertops for meal prepDining Table with Seating for 6 + Kitchen Bar seats 3 moreNatural Gas Grill for Outdoor Cooking*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Whether you're traveling with friends, family, or little ones, the thoughtfully planned bedroom layout ensures there's space and privacy for everyone.1st Floor:Full Guest Bathroom with Rainfall Shower, perfect for rinsing off after a day at the beach2nd Floor:Front Primary Suite: King Bed, Private Balcony, French Doors, and En-suite Bathroom with Dual Vanity and Walk-In ShowerRear Primary Suite: King Bed with Private En-suite Bathroom featuring a Glass-Enclosed ShowerBunk Nook: Twin-Over-Twin Bunk Bed (Perfect for Kids!)*** ROSEMARY BEACH COMMUNITY ***Perfectly situated in Barrett Square, everything you need is within a short walk. Enjoy casual and fine dining, boutique shopping, and scenic pathways. The renowned Rosemary Beach white sand beach is just a stone's throw away. Plus, access to 4 pristine community pools ensures that relaxation is always within reach,Rosemary Beach Community: Beachside destination with award-winning architectureRacquet Club – one of the world’s top 75 tennis spotsMultiple parks & greens with playgrounds, a splash pad, butterfly park, and hidden boardwalks with fountainsFitness Center with massage and yoga4 RESORT POOLSBarbados Pool: Gulf-side, French West Indies style with a fountainCoquina Pool: Gulf-side, with a relaxing negative edge overflowSky Pool: Park-side, indoor, heated year-round with radiant heated decking in winterCabana Pool: Park-side, cabana-style with a children’s pool & playground nearby*** PET POLICY ***Non-shedding, housebroken dogs onlyPets are not allowed on furniture or bedsDogs must be crated when left unattended$250 non-refundable pet fee + tax*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased during checkout or independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentWaiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.Fireplace is not available for guest use.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 33758STRO #: STR-033758

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Essentials: Olive Oil and Salt & Pepper Starter Supplies
